body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> SAMSUNG Electronics displayed Full HD Premium LCD TV PAVV ''Moselle'' at KES 2006. ''Moselle'' named after well-known German white wine province expected to continue its fame along with a great hit of ''Bordeaux'' for the first half year. It is equipped with ''Full HD DNle engine'' and can be connected PC and Blu-ray player.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
